Headless real-UI canary with selected model NOUR Cockpit found data-nour-controls-mode=cockpit, rendered the NOUR Cockpit summary card, marked 33 raw advanced parameter rows, hid all 33 by default, and restored all 33 via Show raw overrides. A second headless canary switched to qwen35-4b-local and verified mode=standard, no summary card, zero hidden raw rows, and Temperature still visible.
